== Description ==

[[Hayes Hunter]] (standing left facing right, tall, dark grey button-down, jeans, grey-streaked beard), [[Logan Pietig]] (back table left facing camera, black UWL hoodie), [[AJ Hatoum]] (standing mid-back, olive jacket, khaki pants, blond hair, clear glasses), [[Karl Koenig]] (standing back right, red zip pullover, jeans), [[Steve Harpster]] (right table left seat, white hair, glasses, black jacket), [[Benji Chu]] (right table standing, navy #99 Judge jersey, black SWCCG cap), [[Chris Wirfs]] (right table back seat, black Solo tee, glasses), and [[Apollo Chu]] (right table right seat (back), blue SpongeBob tee) at the [[2025 World Championship]] on 3 October 2025.
